title: The Teal Titan of Gold's on 5th

Preserve one face and one continuous body identity, connected rounded anatomy, living skin, believable joints, increasing height and limb length, natural fabric tension and grounded floor contact. Deadpan comic documentary tone; subtle gym reactions only.
